clauses.text: 1. Purpose

source_location.excerpt: 1. Purpose

clauses.heading: 1. Purpose
clauses.text: This Billing Schedule Agreement (“Agreement”) is entered into between Northbridge Technology Systems (“Vendor”) and Silverline Financial Services (“Client”) to establish a clear process for invoicing, milestone billing, payment tracking, and resolution of billing discrepancies. The parties intend to maintain accurate records, align charges with delivered goods and services, and reduce avoidable payment delays.

source_location.excerpt: This Billing Schedule Agreement (“Agreement”) is entered into between Northbridge Technology Systems (“Vendor”) and Silverline Financial Services (“Client”) to establish a clear process for invoicing, milestone billing, payment tracking, and resolution of billing discrepancies. The parties intend to maintain accurate records, align charges with delivered goods and services, and reduce avoidable payment delays.

clauses.heading: 1. Purpose
clauses.text: Establish consistent billing dates and supporting-document requirements.

source_location.excerpt: Establish consistent billing dates and supporting-document requirements.

clauses.heading: 1. Purpose
clauses.text: Connect invoices to approved purchase orders, delivery evidence, and acceptance milestones.

source_location.excerpt: Connect invoices to approved purchase orders, delivery evidence, and acceptance milestones.

clauses.heading: 1. Purpose
clauses.text: Provide a documented process for payment follow-up, credit notes, and disputes.

source_location.excerpt: Provide a documented process for payment follow-up, credit notes, and disputes.

clauses.text: This Agreement applies to hardware and related services supplied under purchase orders accepted by both parties, including:

source_location.excerpt: This Agreement applies to hardware and related services supplied under purchase orders accepted by both parties, including:

clauses.heading: 2. Scope of Agreement
clauses.text: Servers, network switches, routers, storage systems, security appliances, and accessories.

source_location.excerpt: Servers, network switches, routers, storage systems, security appliances, and accessories.

clauses.heading: 2. Scope of Agreement
clauses.text: Equipment deliveries to the Client’s offices, data centres, and approved branch locations.

clauses.heading: 2. Scope of Agreement
clauses.text: Installation, configuration, testing, and warranty-related support expressly listed in an accepted purchase order.

source_location.excerpt: Installation, configuration, testing, and warranty-related support expressly listed in an accepted purchase order.

clauses.heading: 2. Scope of Agreement
clauses.text: Any work outside an accepted purchase order must be approved in writing by authorized representatives of both parties before it is billed.

source_location.excerpt: Any work outside an accepted purchase order must be approved in writing by authorized representatives of both parties before it is billed.

clauses.heading: 3.1 Standard Billing
clauses.text: Recurring supply or support arrangements will be invoiced monthly, on the final business day of the billing month.

source_location.excerpt: Recurring supply or support arrangements will be invoiced monthly, on the final business day of the billing month.

clauses.heading: 3.1 Standard Billing
clauses.text: For one-time orders with a value exceeding INR 6,00,000, the Vendor may invoice after delivery confirmation, subject to the relevant purchase order.

source_location.excerpt: For one-time orders with a value exceeding INR 6,00,000, the Vendor may invoice after delivery confirmation, subject to the relevant purchase order.

clauses.heading: 3.1 Standard Billing
clauses.text: Invoices must reference the applicable purchase order and include delivery or service evidence appropriate to the items billed.

source_location.excerpt: Invoices must reference the applicable purchase order and include delivery or service evidence appropriate to the items billed.

clauses.text: 3.3 Payment Terms

source_location.excerpt: 3.3 Payment Terms

clauses.heading: 3.3 Payment Terms
clauses.text: Standard payment term: 45 calendar days from the Client’s receipt of a valid invoice and required supporting documents.

source_location.excerpt: Standard payment term: 45 calendar days from the Client’s receipt of a valid invoice and required supporting documents.

clauses.heading: 3.3 Payment Terms
clauses.text: Late payment interest, where legally permitted and applicable, will be 1.25% per month on undisputed overdue amounts.

source_location.excerpt: Late payment interest, where legally permitted and applicable, will be 1.25% per month on undisputed overdue amounts.

clauses.heading: 3.3 Payment Terms
clauses.text: Any advance payment must be stated in the purchase order and may not exceed 25% of the PO value unless agreed in writing.

source_location.excerpt: Any advance payment must be stated in the purchase order and may not exceed 25% of the PO value unless agreed in writing.

clauses.heading: 3.3 Payment Terms
clauses.text: The Client may withhold the disputed portion of an invoice while the parties investigate; undisputed amounts remain payable under the agreed terms.

source_location.excerpt: The Client may withhold the disputed portion of an invoice while the parties investigate; undisputed amounts remain payable under the agreed terms.

clauses.text: 4.2 Credit Notes and Adjustments

clauses.heading: 4.2 Credit Notes and Adjustments
clauses.text: Credit notes may be issued for approved returns, short deliveries, duplicate charges, or confirmed billing errors.

source_location.excerpt: Credit notes may be issued for approved returns, short deliveries, duplicate charges, or confirmed billing errors.

clauses.heading: 4.2 Credit Notes and Adjustments
clauses.text: Each credit note must identify the original invoice and state the reason and value of the adjustment.

source_location.excerpt: Each credit note must identify the original invoice and state the reason and value of the adjustment.

clauses.heading: 4.2 Credit Notes and Adjustments
clauses.text: Unless applicable law or a written agreement requires otherwise, a credit-note request should be raised within 60 calendar days of the original invoice date.

source_location.excerpt: Unless applicable law or a written agreement requires otherwise, a credit-note request should be raised within 60 calendar days of the original invoice date.

clauses.heading: 4.2 Credit Notes and Adjustments
clauses.text: Approved credits will be reflected in the parties’ billing records and reconciled against the relevant invoice or future invoice, as agreed.

clauses.text: 5. Obligations of the Vendor

source_location.excerpt: 5. Obligations of the Vendor

clauses.heading: 5. Obligations of the Vendor
clauses.text: Supply goods and perform services in accordance with the accepted PO and agreed delivery schedule.

source_location.excerpt: Supply goods and perform services in accordance with the accepted PO and agreed delivery schedule.

clauses.heading: 5. Obligations of the Vendor
clauses.text: Maintain accurate records of dispatch, delivery, installation, testing, and warranty coverage.

source_location.excerpt: Maintain accurate records of dispatch, delivery, installation, testing, and warranty coverage.

clauses.heading: 5. Obligations of the Vendor
clauses.text: Provide complete and legible supporting documents with each invoice.

source_location.excerpt: Provide complete and legible supporting documents with each invoice.

clauses.heading: 5. Obligations of the Vendor
clauses.text: Notify the Client of an expected material delivery delay as soon as reasonably practicable and, where possible, at least 5 business days in advance.

source_location.excerpt: Notify the Client of an expected material delivery delay as soon as reasonably practicable and, where possible, at least 5 business days in advance.

clauses.heading: 5. Obligations of the Vendor
clauses.text: Correct verified invoice errors and issue applicable credit notes or replacement invoices promptly.

source_location.excerpt: Correct verified invoice errors and issue applicable credit notes or replacement invoices promptly.

clauses.text: 6. Obligations of the Client

source_location.excerpt: 6. Obligations of the Client

clauses.heading: 6. Obligations of the Client
clauses.text: Provide valid purchase orders and identify authorized contacts for delivery, invoice, and payment queries.

source_location.excerpt: Provide valid purchase orders and identify authorized contacts for delivery, invoice, and payment queries.

clauses.heading: 6. Obligations of the Client
clauses.text: Review invoices and notify the Vendor of a discrepancy within 5 business days of receipt where practicable.

source_location.excerpt: Review invoices and notify the Vendor of a discrepancy within 5 business days of receipt where practicable.

clauses.heading: 6. Obligations of the Client
clauses.text: Arrange access to approved sites for delivery, installation, and testing activities.

source_location.excerpt: Arrange access to approved sites for delivery, installation, and testing activities.

clauses.heading: 6. Obligations of the Client
clauses.text: Review milestone evidence and provide acceptance or written reasons for rejection within a reasonable period.

source_location.excerpt: Review milestone evidence and provide acceptance or written reasons for rejection within a reasonable period.

clauses.heading: 6. Obligations of the Client
clauses.text: Pay undisputed invoice amounts within the agreed payment period.

source_location.excerpt: Pay undisputed invoice amounts within the agreed payment period.

clauses.text: 7. Dispute Resolution

source_location.excerpt: 7. Dispute Resolution

clauses.heading: 7. Dispute Resolution
clauses.text: A billing dispute must be submitted in writing with the invoice number, disputed amount, reason, and available supporting evidence.

source_location.excerpt: A billing dispute must be submitted in writing with the invoice number, disputed amount, reason, and available supporting evidence.

clauses.heading: 7. Dispute Resolution
clauses.text: The parties’ billing contacts will attempt to resolve the dispute within 10 business days after receiving the written notice.

source_location.excerpt: The parties’ billing contacts will attempt to resolve the dispute within 10 business days after receiving the written notice.

clauses.heading: 7. Dispute Resolution
clauses.text: If the dispute remains unresolved, it will be escalated to designated senior representatives of both parties for good-faith discussion.

source_location.excerpt: If the dispute remains unresolved, it will be escalated to designated senior representatives of both parties for good-faith discussion.

clauses.heading: 7. Dispute Resolution
clauses.text: The parties will continue to process undisputed amounts while a disputed amount is being reviewed, subject to applicable law and the relevant PO.

source_location.excerpt: The parties will continue to process undisputed amounts while a disputed amount is being reviewed, subject to applicable law and the relevant PO.

clauses.text: 8. Reporting and Reconciliation

source_location.excerpt: 8. Reporting and Reconciliation

clauses.heading: 8. Reporting and Reconciliation
clauses.text: The Vendor will provide a monthly statement showing invoices issued, amounts received, open balances, credit notes, and overdue undisputed amounts.

source_location.excerpt: The Vendor will provide a monthly statement showing invoices issued, amounts received, open balances, credit notes, and overdue undisputed amounts.

clauses.heading: 8. Reporting and Reconciliation
clauses.text: Either party may request a quarterly reconciliation of purchase orders, delivery records, milestone approvals, invoices, and payments.

source_location.excerpt: Either party may request a quarterly reconciliation of purchase orders, delivery records, milestone approvals, invoices, and payments.

clauses.heading: 8. Reporting and Reconciliation
clauses.text: Both parties will retain billing and supporting records in accordance with their internal retention policies and applicable legal requirements.

source_location.excerpt: Both parties will retain billing and supporting records in accordance with their internal retention policies and applicable legal requirements.

clauses.text: 9. Confidentiality

source_location.excerpt: 9. Confidentiality

clauses.heading: 9. Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party will protect non-public billing, commercial, operational, and financial information received from the other party and will use it only for purposes connected with this Agreement. Disclosure may be made to personnel or professional advisers who need the information, or where required by law, subject to appropriate confidentiality obligations.

clauses.heading: 10. Amendment and Termination
clauses.text: Any amendment to this Agreement must be recorded in writing and approved by authorized representatives of both parties.

source_location.excerpt: Any amendment to this Agreement must be recorded in writing and approved by authorized representatives of both parties.

clauses.heading: 10. Amendment and Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving 45 calendar days’ written notice, unless a relevant PO states otherwise.

source_location.excerpt: Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving 45 calendar days’ written notice, unless a relevant PO states otherwise.

clauses.heading: 10. Amendment and Termination
clauses.text: Termination will not remove obligations relating to accepted deliveries, approved milestones, valid invoices, credit notes, or payments accrued before the effective termination date.

source_location.excerpt: Termination will not remove obligations relating to accepted deliveries, approved milestones, valid invoices, credit notes, or payments accrued before the effective termination date.

clauses.heading: 10. Amendment and Termination
clauses.text: The parties will cooperate to reconcile open invoices and outstanding obligations following termination.

source_location.excerpt: The parties will cooperate to reconcile open invoices and outstanding obligations following termination.
